feedback: The submitted code does not implement the required function `maximumSum`. Instead, it only contains an empty `main` function, which does not read input, process the array, or return the correct result. As a result, all public test cases fail. A correct solution must implement the `Solution::maximumSum` method using dynamic programming to track the maximum subarray sum with zero or one deletion.
optimization_hint: Implement a DP solution with two states: dp0[i] = max subarray sum ending at i with no deletion, dp1[i] = max subarray sum ending at i with exactly one deletion. Transition: dp0[i] = max(nums[i], dp0[i-1] + nums[i]); dp1[i] = max(dp0[i-1], dp1[i-1] + nums[i]). Answer is max over all dp0[i] and dp1[i]. Handle all-negative case by ensuring at least one element is chosen.
